correctness.rationale: The convolution map from m+1 Gaussian coordinates to a fixed row combination has all nonzero singular values uniformly bounded below: its Toeplitz Gram eigenvalues are 1+2|ab|cos(kπ/(m+1)), so the lower bound is 1−cos(π/(m+1))>0. Spherical small-ball probability for a fixed row direction is O(t^{βm}); a projective β-dimensional t-net yields O(t^{β(m−1)}). A geometric-progression rank-one locus has residual coordinates with triangular Jacobian one and a bounded-density chart giving matching lower power. The independent Gaussian radius has the required negative moments. Layer-cake gives E||H†||^p,Eκ^p finite exactly p<β(m−1), divergent including equality. Verified algebraic rank and covariance bounds independently; 808 finite exact/numeric checks do not prove probability asymptotics.
